# Requirements Quality Checklist: Realistic Lighting, Shadows & Material Rendering

**Purpose**: Unit tests for requirements writing — validate completeness, clarity, consistency, measurability and coverage of the spec/plan documents before implementation (NOT implementation verification)
**Created**: 2026-10-20
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) (supporting docs: [plan.md](../plan.md), [research.md](../research.md), [data-model.md](../data-model.md), [quickstart.md](../quickstart.md))

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 - Are requirements complete for the combined effect of the new ambient light and the existing main-light controls on overall scene brightness? [Gap, Spec §FR-001/FR-006]
- [ ] CHK002 - Are requirements defined for the state of every lighting control (ambient level, shadow switch, main light) at the moment the viewer starts? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004/FR-011]
- [ ] CHK003 - Are requirements defined for the behavior of lighting controls when no model is displayed (empty state)? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK004 - Are accessibility requirements specified for the new controls beyond English labeling (keyboard operation, state announcement for assistive technologies)? [Gap, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK005 - Are requirements defined that distinguish page-reload behavior from model-switch behavior for lighting settings? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004/Assumptions]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 - Is the ambient slider scale defined unambiguously, including what values 0 and 100 mean for scene brightness? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002/US1-A2/A3]
- [ ] CHK007 - Is the term "immediately" in the shadow-switch requirement quantified or bounded in time? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK008 - Is "smooth" rotation/zoom with shadows active expressed as a criterion a non-technical person can judge? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-010/SC-004]
- [ ] CHK009 - Is the exact user-visible label for the shadow switch specified in the spec itself (not only inferable from supporting docs)? [Gap, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK010 - Is the interaction between high ambient levels and reduced shadow contrast documented as expected behavior rather than left to inference? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK011 - Is the 5-second model-load criterion defined with explicit start and stop reference points? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010/SC-004]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK012 - Are FR-004, US1-A4 and the session-persistence assumption mutually consistent about when lighting settings reset? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004/US1-A4/Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK013 - Are the shadow-switch semantics consistent between US2-A4, FR-011 and the LightingSettings data model? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011/US2-A4]
- [ ] CHK014 - Is the "no floor surface" clarification consistently reflected across FR-005, Edge Cases and Assumptions with no leftover contradictory wording? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005/Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK015 - Are the new controls required to follow the same interaction conventions as the existing light controls (live value display, toggle-button state indication)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002/FR-011]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK016 - Can the "90% of metal surfaces" judgment in SC-003 be performed objectively by a non-technical tester? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK017 - Is SC-001's "under 10 seconds" measurable with simple tools (e.g., stopwatch) as the constitution requires? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK018 - Are all success criteria written without references to implementation technology? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001…SC-005]
- [ ] CHK019 - Does each functional requirement FR-001…FR-011 have at least one acceptance scenario, edge case or quickstart scenario covering it? [Traceability, Spec §FR-001…FR-011]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK020 - Are alternate flows defined for users who keep default lighting and never touch the new controls? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK021 - Are exception scenarios defined for models lacking shadow-casting geometry or surface-finish data? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases/US3-A3]
- [ ] CHK022 - Are recovery requirements defined for control combinations that make the model unviewable (ambient 0 with main light off)? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK023 - Are non-functional scenarios for low-power mobile devices expressed as judgeable outcomes rather than adjectives like "noticeably sluggish"? [Ambiguity, Spec §Edge Cases/SC-004]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK024 - Are slider boundary values (ambient exactly 0 and exactly 100) behaviorally specified? [Edge Case, Spec §US1-A2/A3]
- [ ] CHK025 - Is an acceptable quality threshold defined for shadow artifacts on thin or overlapping geometry? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK026 - Is the expected shadow behavior while the emissive (unlit) display mode is active specified? [Gap, Edge Case, Spec §FR-008]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK027 - Are performance requirements covering the added rendering work (shadows, environment lighting) stated with explicit budgets? [NFR, Spec §FR-010/SC-004]
- [ ] CHK028 - Are mobile requirements defined beyond the general "responsive" constraint (e.g., usability of new controls on small screens)? [Gap, Spec §SC-004]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK029 - Is the dependency on model files carrying surface-finish data documented together with the fallback requirement? [Dependency, Spec §US3-A3/Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK030 - Is the "Blender reference render" dependency concretely defined (who provides it, which model/view it corresponds to)? [Dependency, Ambiguity, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK031 - Are remaining provisional values (default ambient level marked "assumed: 50") either confirmed as requirements or explicitly accepted as assumptions? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-004/Assumptions]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK032 - Is the potential ambiguity between the shadow switch and the main-light switch (both can make shadows disappear, for different reasons) documented for reviewers? [Conflict, Spec §FR-006/FR-011]
- [ ] CHK033 - Does any spec wording still imply that shadows fall on a surface other than the model itself? [Conflict, Spec §FR-005/Clarifications]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit.implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit.specify` and `/speckit.clarify`; do not apply its exception to this checklist
- Every item tests the WRITTEN requirements (spec/plan), never the implementation behavior — see command definition for the "unit tests for English" metaphor
- Items reference spec sections (`§FR`, `§SC`, `§US`, `§Edge Cases`) or carry `[Gap]`/`[Ambiguity]`/`[Conflict]`/`[Dependency]` markers for traceability
- Highest-risk items for this feature by impact: CHK016 (Blender comparison objectivity), CHK019 (FR→scenario traceability), CHK026 (emissive × shadows interaction), CHK032 (dual shadow-removal controls)
